title.purpose: Project name and the Notes heading.

note.purpose: Note text, the one thing read at length.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The 0.12s press and hover response on controls.

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: An icon tool in the left island; magenta when pressed.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Box"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4" y="6" width="16" height="12" rx="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-tool { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-tool:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--surface); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pin
components.description: The numbered button that ties a mark to its note.
components.css: .ds-pin { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #e0383e; color: #08090b; font: 600 11px/20px ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Note Action
components.description: A quiet text action under a note.
components.css: .ds-action { border: 0; padding: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: BoardSimple is a work surface, not a destination. The screens under review and the marks made on them are the only things that speak.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, magenta from the app icon, used only for the active tool and focus.
Mark colours belong to the user's feedback, never to the interface.
Floating islands on a dotted canvas; the canvas holds the depth, the islands hold the controls.
Every string exists in Estonian and English.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Magenta marks the current tool and keyboard focus. It never decorates, and it never stands for a note.

rules.name: The Readable Number Rule
rules.body: A number on a mark is white unless white misses 4.5:1 on that colour; then it is on-mark-dark.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for figures and file names. A label in sentence case stays in the body face.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: There are islands and there are pages. A third level means a component has no business existing.

dos: Do send every colour and font through a token in public/style.css.
Do add new text to both languages in public/i18n.js.
Do keep every control reachable by keyboard, with :focus-visible showing the accent ring.
Do keep a destructive action undoable.
donts: Don't use the accent for anything but the current tool and focus.
Don't add a web font, a third surface height or a decorative animation.
Don't make a pointer-only control; a click on a div is a bug here.
Don't add npm dependencies. The app ships as plain files.
